hook_text: A semicircle has a straight side. So is it a polygon? Not so fast.
clip_script: A craft club in Gqeberha tips out a box of card shapes for a mobile. Sort by sides: only straight, only curved, or both. Triangles and hexagons: only straight. Circles and ovals: only curved. The semicircle has one of each, so it goes with both. Now count the sides. A tiny triangle and a huge one go together: 3 sides each. Then draw on grid paper. 5 squares right, 3 up, 5 left, 3 down: a perfect rectangle. Count squares, not lines.
visual_style: Card shapes sliding into three labelled trays, then a pencil tracing a rectangle on grid paper.
mood: Hands-on and cheerful, like a craft table on a Friday afternoon.
pacing: Quick sort, the semicircle twist, then a slow careful drawing.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw three different polygons on grid paper.
